name: Somalia
prevalence_note: Somalia has thin official scam typology: the Central Bank licenses mobile-money providers and the NCA ties its SIM registration rules and traffic monitoring to fraud, identity theft and SIM-box abuse, but neither publishes a detailed consumer scam list.
cross_border_note: Most wallet traffic runs on operator USD wallets reached by USSD; callers would usually speak Somali, and diaspora remittance flows mean some contact comes from foreign numbers.

scams.name: Wallet PIN or reset-code request after a fake mistaken transfer
scams.name_en: Wallet PIN or reset-code request after a fake mistaken transfer

red_flag_keywords.text: I sent dollars to your number by mistake, send them back
give me the code so I can reverse it
your wallet will be closed unless you confirm the PIN

scams.signals_en: A message mimicking an incoming wallet credit is followed by a call asking the subscriber to return the money or to share a PIN or reset code so the sender can reverse it; the credit never actually reached the wallet.
scams.legit_en: CBS mobile-money rules make licensed providers responsible for protecting customer funds and handling claims, so disputed or mistaken transfers belong with the provider's own complaint process, not a stranger.
bait_tactics: The balance in my wallet menu still shows the same dollars as this morning.
This SIM belongs to my cousin abroad and I cannot open his wallet.
The phone battery is at two percent and the charger is at the shop.

scams.name: Fake operator agent asking to verify or re-register a SIM
scams.name_en: Fake operator agent asking to verify or re-register a SIM

red_flag_keywords.text: your SIM will be blocked today unless you verify by phone
tell me your ID details and the code we sent
I am from customer care, re-register your line now

scams.signals_en: A caller claiming to be operator customer care uses the national SIM registration drive as cover, threatening a cut-off unless the subscriber dictates identity details or a code that could let the caller take over the line.
scams.legit_en: The NCA's SIM registration guidelines tie verification to operator registration and KYC checks, aimed at stopping fraud and identity theft; they do not describe remote verification by an unsolicited caller.
bait_tactics: My line was registered in person at the Mogadishu branch last month, so there is nothing pending.
My identity card is with my father in Hargeisa this week.
This old phone cannot receive SMS any more, only calls.
